entries.zh: 烹死；把恶人／罪犯烹煮处死（烹刑处死）
entries.en: to boil/roast (an evildoer, criminal) to death; execution by boiling

entries.zh: 烹肉；烹煮肉食、煮肉
entries.en: to cook (boil/roast) meat; to stew meat

entries.zh: 焙；置于火上焙烤，烘焙、焙干
entries.en: to broil on a gridiron/grill; to bake or parch over a slow fire

entries.zh: 火焙死人；用火把人焙烤至死（如圣劳伦斯殉道受烤刑）
entries.en: to roast a person to death over fire; martyred by roasting (as St. Lawrence on the gridiron)
entries.notes: M 栏'死'之声调标记污损难辨（T99），西栏 'as. lorenço' 缩写展开依赖推断（当指圣洛伦索烤刑殉道）；'火焙死人＝用火将人烤死'之义据汉字栏与西栏尚可互证

entries.zh: 炮；以猛火炮焙、炮炙（指物料货品，非火炮义）
entries.en: to roast/scorch (goods, provisions) over a fierce fire
entries.notes: 西栏 recado 取马尼拉贸易语境'物料／货品'义；M 栏 'Pu.'、R 栏 'Pam.' 形似截短，义据汉字'炮'（猛火炮焙）

entries.zh: 火炮术语（或指炮之首部／炮手头目），与西栏对应不明，释义存疑
entries.en: uncertain artillery term ('cannon head' or 'chief gunner'); Spanish line mismatched
entries.notes: 西栏 'asar cañones' 与汉字'炮手頭'难以互证，疑栏位错置，语义无法定夺

entries.zh: 炮烧；以猛火炮燎，烧灼、燎烤
entries.en: to scorch/singe with fierce fire; to burn over
entries.notes: 西栏 'hostar' 词形不明（或为 ustar／arder 类讹形），义据汉字'炮燒'

entries.zh: 乞者讨火来焙烤、取暖（人向人讨火自焙）
entries.en: for a beggar (man) to beg fire or embers to roast/warm himself
entries.notes: 西栏 asar al hombre（烤人）与汉字'乞人討火焙'的对应需推断（讨火自焙之义）

entries.zh: 字义未定（'腹胼'第二字或作'膀'），释义存疑
entries.en: asa (handle of a vessel/tool) — Chinese gloss 腹胼/腹膀 unresolved; sense uncertain
entries.notes: 汉字'腹胼'第二字两可且与西栏 Asa（柄把）难以互证，语义无法定夺

entries.zh: 烧红；被火烧红、烧得红热
entries.en: roasted by fire; red-hot, glowing/charred

entries.zh: 烧红的炭火；火烬、余炭
entries.en: glowing red charcoal; ember (ascua)

entries.zh: 烧红的火炭；炭火余烬
entries.en: ember; red-hot live coal

entries.zh: 张；张紧、张开（张线张物之'张'）
entries.en: to stretch/spread taut (a line, cord or net)
entries.notes: 西栏 'A sechar hari.' 词形残讹（hari 未详），义据 M 'Tiõ'／R 'chiang' 定为'張'（张紧）

entries.zh: 释义存疑（'张眉'第二字或作'鬼'；西栏残讹难解）
entries.en: uncertain — possibly 'to knit/raise the brows' (張眉) or a ghost-related phrase (張鬼); Spanish text garbled
entries.notes: 汉字第二字眉／鬼两可（M 'guiog'、R 'guio' 倾向'鬼'），西栏 'penganas ha tenptera' 残讹，语义无法定夺

entries.zh: 张持；拉张持稳，张而持之
entries.en: to stretch and hold taut
entries.notes: 西栏 'estira alerta' 需推断（当为 estírala，拉张使紧），义据汉字'張持'

entries.zh: 张网；张设罗网以候捕，兼有窥伺义
entries.en: to spread/set a net; to lie in wait watching

entries.zh: 窥视、偷看（疑字'瞷'，或作'间'）
entries.en: to peer at / spy on furtively
entries.notes: 疑字取'瞷'（窥视）义，与西栏 asechar（窥伺）及 M/R 'cam' 相合

entries.zh: 窥看、偷窥
entries.en: to peep / spy on
entries.notes: M 栏附加音写 'giun; tau ban cuã' 未详，本义据'窺'（kui/cuy）四栏取窥看

entries.zh: 窥见；偷看而见
entries.en: to peep and see; to catch sight of (by spying)

entries.zh: 闯；探头张望（西栏谓小心探头），亦谓闯入
entries.en: to put one's head out cautiously to peer; to barge/rush in
entries.notes: 西栏 'Apechar' 为非常规词形，据下条 'sacando la cabeça por la bentana'（探头出窗）定为探头张望义

entries.zh: 把头伸出窗外张望，探头看
entries.en: to stick/poke one's head out (the window) and look

entries.zh: 探听、打听消息
entries.en: to sound out; to find out by inquiry (informarse)
entries.notes: 疑字'探／採'经 M 音写 tham 判为'探'，不影响语义
